name: Source Scout Agent
purpose: Collect public official and community signals without login, scraping bypasses, or copied guide content.
cadence: official sources every 6 hours; community sources daily during MVP

name: Demand Classifier Agent
purpose: Score whether a signal looks like a repeated player problem, a free SEO page, or a future paid audit use case.

name: Patch Sentinel Agent
purpose: Flag pages and claims that should be reviewed after patches, hotfixes, balance notes, wipe changes, or economy movement.

name: Guide Draft Agent
purpose: Turn approved repeated problems into original checklists, scorecards, calculators, and source-aware page drafts.
cadence: manual approval during MVP; weekly batch after validation

name: Publish QA Agent
purpose: Check hidden paid links, legal guardrails, source notes, sitemap inclusion, and whether patch-sensitive wording is honest.

name: Shadow Answer Author Agent
purpose: Draft a no-charge candidate answer from one closed benchmark case and refuse unsupported scope instead of guessing.
cadence: when a new unique paid-answer benchmark is queued

name: Independent Shadow Answer QA Agent
purpose: Review every candidate claim and calculation against the closed evidence without seeing or trusting the author's reasoning.

name: Complex Match Peer QA Agent
purpose: Blindly repeat the independent review for complex match products so reviewer agreement can be measured before activation.
cadence: after every complex-match shadow answer candidate
